column1: # h2spec 2.6.0's failures against gaato/mttp_ng's HTTP/2 server that are
# known and explained (scripts/h2spec.mbtx), run with -P /wait so that a
# request's stream is still open when the next frame of a test arrives.
# Columns, separated by one tab: the mode (tls or h2c); the nghttp2 versions
# the failure is known for, separated by spaces, or `*` for a failure of
# this module's own that every version shows; h2spec's package; its test
# For an nghttp2 version this table names, a failure not listed for it
# fails the script, and so does a listed one that passes, so the list only
# shrinks. For a version it does not name, the rows of other versions are
# notes, and only a failure no row lists fails. CI's Debian 13 has 1.64.0;
# 1.71.0 is the newest the rows were taken from.

column4: closed: Sends a DATA frame after sending RST_STREAM frame
column5: nghttp2 1.71.0 drops frames for a stream it no longer keeps: the server answered and closed the stream before the frame came, and the stream is not retained, so nghttp2 cannot tell it from one never used (lib/nghttp2_session.c, session_on_data_received_fail_fast). 1.64.0 answers as h2spec expects.

column5: nghttp2 1.71.0 drops frames for a stream it no longer keeps: the server answered and closed the stream before the frame came, and the stream is not retained, so nghttp2 cannot tell it from one never used (lib/nghttp2_session.c, session_on_data_received_fail_fast). 1.64.0 answers as h2spec expects.

column4: Sends stream identifier that is numerically smaller than previous
column5: nghttp2 ignores a HEADERS frame whose stream it no longer keeps instead of answering PROTOCOL_ERROR (it cannot tell an old identifier from a reused one); the frame is dropped, not processed.

column4: Sends PRIORITY frame that depend on itself
column5: nghttp2 1.71.0 does not validate PRIORITY frames, whose signal RFC 9113 deprecated (section 5.3.2): it parses the frame and acts on none of it. 1.64.0 validates them.

column4: Sends a PRIORITY frame with 0x0 stream identifier
column5: nghttp2 1.71.0 does not validate PRIORITY frames, whose signal RFC 9113 deprecated (section 5.3.2): it parses the frame and acts on none of it. 1.64.0 validates them.

column4: Sends multiple WINDOW_UPDATE frames increasing the flow control window to above 2^31-1 on a stream
column5: nghttp2 1.71.0 ends the whole connection with GOAWAY(FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR) where h2spec expects only the stream reset, which 1.64.0 sends; RFC 9113, section 6.9.1 lets the endpoint do either.

With h2c the cleartext port also serves HTTP/1.1, and bytes that are not the HTTP/2 preface are taken as an HTTP/1.1 request (@h2server.serve): the server waits for its head instead of answering GOAWAY.
